summary: Comprehensive testing of MotoGP and Isle of Man TT circuit maps on event detail pages. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend maps render correctly with proper section filtering functionality.

issues: Minor: SVG map section names (Turn 1 Stand, Chicane Stand, Main Grandstand) don't exactly match API ticket data section names (Turn 1, Main Straight). The sections without matching tickets appear faded (opacity 0.15). Functional but could confuse users expecting to click on SVG sections.

critical_code_review_comments: InteractiveVenueMap.jsx: MotoGP SVG map renders with all circuit elements (Turn 1, Chicane, Pit Straight, Final Corner, GA Zones, VIP Village, Paddock Access)
InteractiveVenueMap.jsx: Isle of Man TT Snaefell Mountain Course map renders with famous landmarks (Grandstand, Bray Hill, Quarter Bridge, Ballaugh Bridge, Ramsey Hairpin, The Mountain)
Legend buttons correctly show only sections with available tickets, with ticket counts displayed
Section filtering via legend buttons works correctly - clicking a section shows 'Showing: {section}' indicator and filters ticket listings
All event images load correctly from Unsplash and emergentagent.com CDN
All ticket prices are competitive - max price €401.30 (VIP Harry Styles), well under €2,100 threshold
MotoGP events properly detected via event_type='motogp'
IOM TT events properly detected via title containing 'Isle of Man' even when event_type is 'motogp'
seed_data_creation: None - used existing events: event_fb49b98c7df6 (Qatar MotoGP 2026), premium_75d01878d4e7 (Isle of Man TT 2026 - Senior Race)
